blocks.prompt:
1 Describe the laboratory preparation of ethanal from ethanol. Explain the conditions used and how the preparation of a ketone from a secondary alcohol differs. (4 marks)
(Ethanol se ethanal ki laboratory tayyari bayan karein. Istemal hone wali conditions samjhayein aur batayein ke secondary alcohol se ketone ki tayyari kaise mukhtalif hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Usool: aldehydes primary alcohols ko acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ ya acidified KMnO₄ se oxidise kar ke banaye jate hain.
CH₃–CH₂–OH + [O] → CH₃–CHO + H₂O (K₂Cr₂O₇ + H₂SO₄(aq), garmi)

Tareeqa (Figure 23.1):
• Acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ ko garam ethanol mein qatra qatra dala jata hai.
• Banne wala ethanal bante hi distil kar liya jata hai. Is se is ki mazeed oxidation ethanoic acid mein nahi hoti.
• Temperature ethanal (acetaldehyde) ke boiling point se zyada magar ethanol ke boiling point se kam rakha jata hai, kyun ke ethanol ka boiling point zyada hai; is liye ethanal distil ho jata hai aur ethanol peeche rehta hai.
• Khalis ethanal redistillation se milta hai.

Ketones: isi tareeqe se secondary alcohols se bante hain, jaise
CH₃–CH(OH)–CH₃ + [O] → CH₃–CO–CH₃ + H₂O (propan-2-ol → propanone)
In conditions mein ketones carboxylic acids mein tabdeel nahi hote, is liye ketone ko foran distil nahi kiya jata.

book_ref.quote: the acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ is added drop wise to the warm ethanol

blocks.prompt:
2 Explain the structure of the carbonyl group and the two structural features that decide its reactions. Why are aldehydes more reactive than ketones? (4 marks)
(Carbonyl group ki structure aur woh do structural khoobiyan samjhayein jo is ke reactions tay karti hain. Aldehydes ketones se zyada reactive kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Structure: >C=O mein carbon aur oxygen dono sp² hybridized hain. Carbon oxygen se double bond (σ + π) aur do doosre groups se single bonds se juda hai; group planar hai.
Polarity: oxygen zyada electronegative hai, is liye us par δ⁻ aur carbon par δ⁺ aata hai: >C^δ⁺=O^δ⁻.

Do structural khoobiyan:
1. δ⁺ charge ki wajah se carbonyl carbon electrophilic hai aur nucleophiles is par hamla kar sakte hain.
2. π bond aasani se toot jata hai, is liye double bond addition reactions karta hai; planar shape carbonyl carbon ko khula rakhti hai jo addition mein mazeed madad deti hai.
Is liye khaas reactions nucleophilic addition (aur α-carbon specific) reactions hain.

Aldehydes ketones se zyada reactive hain:
• Inductive effect: ketone mein do alkyl groups ka electron releasing effect carbonyl carbon ka positive charge kam karta hai, is liye hamla mushkil hota hai.
• Steric hindrance: ketone ke do alkyl groups hamla karne wale nucleophile ka rasta rokte hain.

book_ref.quote: Two structural features of the carbonyl group determine the chemistry and properties

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the addition of hydrogen cyanide to propanone: how HCN is provided, the role of free CN⁻ ions, the steps of the reaction and the use of the product. (4 marks)
(Propanone mein hydrogen cyanide ka addition bayan karein: HCN kaise mohayya hoti hai, free CN⁻ ions ka kirdar, reaction ke steps aur product ka istemal.)
blocks.explanation:
Reaction: aldehydes aur ketones HCN se mil kar cyanohydrins banate hain.
CH₃COCH₃ + HCN → (CH₃)₂C(OH)CN (2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile)

HCN mohayya karna: HCN intehai zehreeli gas hai, is liye seedhi istemal nahi hoti. KCN (ya NaCN) solution aur carbonyl compound ke mixture mein aahista nap-tol se acid (HCl) dala jata hai: KCN + HCl → HCN + KCl.

CN⁻ ka kirdar: HCN na nucleophile hai (is ke carbon par lone pair nahi) na strong acid, is liye kafi CN⁻ nahi deta. Thora zyada KCN liya jata hai ta ke free CN⁻ ions maujood hon; yeh reaction shuru karte aur munasib raftaar se catalyse karte hain.

Steps:
1. Nucleophile CN⁻ δ⁺ carbonyl carbon par hamla karta hai; π electrons oxygen par chale jate hain aur alkoxide ion (CH₃)₂C(O⁻)CN banta hai.
2. Alkoxide ion HCN se H⁺ leta hai, cyanohydrin banta hai aur CN⁻ wapas mil jata hai.
Dono steps reversible hain magar equilibria bahut daayein taraf hain, is liye yield zyada hoti hai.

Istemal: 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile Perspex banane mein intermediate hai. Nitriles hydrolyse ho kar carboxylic acids dete hain.

book_ref.quote: HCN is obtained by adding a controlled amount of an acid to a mixture of KCN and the carbonyl compound.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: asal hamla CN⁻ karta hai, HCN nahi. HCN sirf aakhir mein H⁺ deta hai aur CN⁻ dobara ban jata hai – isi liye thora sa CN⁻ catalyst ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
4 Explain the reduction of aldehydes and ketones by hydride ion. Give the reduction of propanal and of propanone and outline how the hydride ion reacts. (4 marks)
(Hydride ion se aldehydes aur ketones ki reduction samjhayein. Propanal aur propanone ki reduction likhein aur batayein ke hydride ion kaise react karta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Kyun ke aldehydes aur ketones alcohols ki oxidation se bante hain, is liye in ki reduction se alcohols wapas milte hain. NaBH₄ ya LiAlH₄ jaise reducing agent (hydride ion, H⁻, ka zariya) se:
• aldehydes primary alcohols dete hain: CH₃CH₂CHO + 2[H] → CH₃CH₂CH₂OH (propan-1-ol)
• ketones secondary alcohols dete hain: CH₃COCH₃ + 2[H] → CH₃CH(OH)CH₃ (propan-2-ol)
[H] NaBH₄ se aane wala reducing H hai jo equation balance karne ke liye likha jata hai; yeh atomic hydrogen nahi.

Hydride ion kaise react karta hai (nucleophilic addition):
1. Hydride ion H⁻ (nucleophile) δ⁺ carbonyl carbon par hamla karta hai; π electrons oxygen par chale jate hain aur alkoxide ion banta hai.
2. Alkoxide ion pani (aqueous solution) se H⁺ le kar alcohol ban jata hai.
Aldehydes ketones se zyada aasani se react karte hain kyun ke ketone ka carbon kam δ⁺ aur zyada ghira hua hai.

book_ref.quote: alcohols can be produced by the reduction of aldehydes and ketones

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the reaction of carbonyl compounds with 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine. Why is it called a condensation reaction and how is it used? (4 marks)
(Carbonyl compounds ka 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine se reaction bayan karein. Ise condensation reaction kyun kehte hain aur yeh kaise istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Reaction: aldehydes aur ketones 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine (2,4-DNPH) ke saath condensation (addition-elimination) reaction kar ke wazeh melting points wale orange qalmi thos dete hain.
Misaal: ethanal + 2,4-DNPH → ethanal 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazone (orange crystals) + H₂O
CH₃CHO + H₂N–NH–C₆H₃(NO₂)₂ → CH₃CH=N–NH–C₆H₃(NO₂)₂ + H₂O

Condensation kyun: reagent ka –NH₂ group pehle C=O par add hota hai (addition), phir pani ka aik molecule kharij hota hai aur dono molecules C=N se jud jate hain.

Istemal:
• Yeh reagent carbonyl compounds (aldehydes aur ketones) pehchanne mein istemal hota hai: orange precipitate aldehyde ya ketone ke >C=O ko zahir karta hai.
• Crystals ka melting point khaas compound pehchanne mein madad deta hai.
• Carboxylic acids, esters, acyl halides aur amides mein bhi >C=O hai magar yeh test nahi dete.
Note: 2,4-DNPH reagent hai; orange crystals hydrazone product hain.

book_ref.quote: Other classes of organic compounds like carboxylic acids, esters, acyl halides, amides etc

blocks.prompt:
6 Describe Tollens' test and Fehling's test with equations. Why do ketones not give these tests? (4 marks)
(Tollens' test aur Fehling's test equations ke saath bayan karein. Ketones yeh tests kyun nahi dete?)
blocks.explanation:
Aldehydes weak aur strong dono oxidising agents se aasani se oxidise hote hain. Ketones oxidation se katraate hain kyun ke C–C bond torna parta hai, is liye sirf strong oxidising agents se oxidise hote hain. Tollens' aur Fehling's reagents weak oxidising agents hain, is liye sirf aldehydes response dete hain.

Tollens' test:
• Reagent: ammoniacal silver nitrate, aqueous alkaline solution mein silver ions:
AgNO₃ + 3NH₄OH → [Ag(NH₃)₂]OH + NH₄NO₃ + 2H₂O
• Aldehyde ke saath halka garam karne par Ag⁺ silver metal mein reduce ho kar test tube ki deewar par silver mirror banata hai (aldehyde acid / us ke namak mein oxidise hota hai). Glucose ka dilute solution isi tarah gharelu aaine banane mein istemal hota tha.

Fehling's test:
• Reagent: aqueous alkaline medium mein Cu²⁺ ions ka chamakdar neela solution, tartaric acid ke namak se complex.
• Aldehyde ke saath garam karne par Cu²⁺, Cu⁺ mein reduce ho kar copper(I) oxide ka brick-red precipitate banata hai:
R–CHO + 2Cu(OH)₂ + NaOH → R–COO⁻Na⁺ + Cu₂O↓ + 3H₂O

Ketones na silver mirror dete hain na laal precipitate.

book_ref.quote: Aldehydes and ketones are oxidized to form carboxylic acids.

blocks.prompt:
7 Which compounds give the iodoform test? Write the iodoform reactions of ethanal and propanone, and explain why ethanol gives the test but methanol does not. (4 marks)
(Kaun se compounds iodoform test dete hain? Ethanal aur propanone ke iodoform reactions likhein, aur samjhayein ke ethanol test kyun deta hai jab ke methanol nahi.)
blocks.explanation:
Aldehydes aur ketones alpha position par halogens se aasani se substitution karte hain. CH₃CO– (acetyl / ethanoyl) group wale compounds – aldehydes mein sirf ethanal, ketones mein sirf methyl ketones – NaOH ki maujoodgi mein iodine se mil kar triiodomethane, CHI₃, banate hain jo zard qalmi thos iodoform kehlata hai. Zard precipitate CH₃CO– group ko zahir karta hai.

Ethanal: CH₃CHO + 3I₂ + 4NaOH → CHI₃↓ + HCOO⁻Na⁺ + 3NaI + 3H₂O (sodium methanoate)
Propanone: CH₃COCH₃ + 3I₂ + 4NaOH → CHI₃↓ + CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + 3NaI + 3H₂O (sodium ethanoate)

Ethanol: is mein CH₃–CH(OH)– group hai. Alkali mein iodine pehle ise ethanal, CH₃CHO, mein oxidise karti hai jis mein CH₃–C=O group hai aur phir iodoform banta hai:
CH₃CH₂OH + 4I₂ + 6NaOH → CHI₃ + HCOONa + 5NaI + 5H₂O
Methanol se CH₃–C=O wala compound nahi ban sakta, is liye iodoform nahi banta.

book_ref.quote: Thus it can also form iodoform, and the test is positive for ethanol.

blocks.prompt:
8 What are carboxylic acids? Give three examples with their sources and explain their physical properties (boiling point, glacial acetic acid, solubility, fatty acids). (4 marks)
(Carboxylic acids kya hain? Teen misaalein zariye ke saath dein aur in ki physical properties (boiling point, glacial acetic acid, solubility, fatty acids) samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Carboxylic acids woh organic compounds hain jin mein carboxyl functional group, –COOH, hota hai (general structure R–COOH).
Misaalein: methanoic acid (formic acid, cheentiyon mein); ethanoic acid (acetic acid, sirke mein); butanoic acid (butyric acid, kharab makkhan mein).

Physical properties:
• Boiling points: chhote carboxylic acids room temperature par zyada boiling point wale liquids hain, hydrogen bonding ki wajah se; acetic acid ke do molecules hydrogen bonds se dimer bana lete hain.
• Glacial acetic acid: ethanoic acid 17 °C par pighalta aur 118 °C par ubalta hai. Is ka melting point room temperature (25 °C) ke qareeb hai, is liye sardi mein jam jata hai; thos khalis acid glacier jaisa lagta hai aur glacial acetic acid kehlata hai.
• Solubility: pani se hydrogen bonding ki wajah se chhote acids (methanoic aur ethanoic acid) pani mein hal hote hain.
• Fatty acids: lambi chain wale aliphatic monocarboxylic acids, jaise stearic, palmitic (C₁₆H₃₂O₂, palm oil mein) aur oleic acids, jo vegetable oils mein triglycerides ki shakal mein hote hain. Lambi hydrophobic alkyl chains ki wajah se yeh pani mein hal nahi hote.

book_ref.quote: Lower carboxylic acids are generally liquids at room temperature, having high boiling points.

blocks.prompt:
9 How do the conditions of oxidation decide whether a primary alcohol gives an aldehyde or a carboxylic acid? Describe the preparation of ethanoic acid from ethanol and of benzoic acid from methylbenzene. (4 marks)
(Oxidation ki conditions kaise tay karti hain ke primary alcohol aldehyde dega ya carboxylic acid? Ethanol se ethanoic acid aur methylbenzene se benzoic acid ki tayyari bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Primary alcohol pehle aldehyde aur phir carboxylic acid mein oxidise hota hai; conditions tay karti hain ke yeh kahan rukega:

Benzoic acid (benzenecarboxylic acid): methylbenzene acidified KMnO₄ ya K₂Cr₂O₇ se aasani se oxidise hota hai; –CH₃ side chain –COOH ban jati hai:
C₆H₅CH₃ + 3[O] → C₆H₅COOH + H₂O

book_ref.quote: Carboxylic acids are prepared by the oxidation of primary alcohols and aldehydes.

rows: Acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ garam alcohol mein qatra qatra
Zyada acidified KMnO₄ ya K₂Cr₂O₇ ke saath reflux
Aldehyde garam mixture mein rehta hai (reflux)

blocks.prompt:
10 Explain how ethanoic acid is obtained by hydrolysis of (i) ethanenitrile and (ii) ethyl ethanoate, in acidic and in alkaline medium. (4 marks)
(Samjhayein ke (i) ethanenitrile aur (ii) ethyl ethanoate ki hydrolysis se acidic aur alkaline medium mein ethanoic acid kaise milta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Ethanenitrile (alkane nitrile) ki hydrolysis
• Acidic medium: seedha carboxylic acid mein hydrolyse hota hai:
CH₃CN + 2H₂O + HCl → CH₃COOH + NH₄Cl
• Alkaline medium: pehle acid ka namak banta hai jo acidification par acid deta hai:
CH₃CN + NaOH + H₂O → CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + NH₃
CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + HCl → CH₃COOH + NaCl

(ii) Ethyl ethanoate (ester) ki hydrolysis, dilute acid ya dilute alkali ke saath reflux
• Acidic medium (reversible): CH₃COOC₂H₅ + H₂O ⇌ CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH
• Alkaline medium: CH₃COOC₂H₅ + NaOH → CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + C₂H₅OH
NaOH ke saath bana hua acid namak ban jata hai, is liye reaction mukammal hota hai (one-way arrow); namak ki acidification se ethanoic acid milta hai:
CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + HCl → CH₃COOH + NaCl

book_ref.quote: When an ester is refluxed with either dilute acid or dilute alkali

blocks.prompt:
11 Why do carboxylic acids show acidic character? Write the reactions of ethanoic acid with an active metal, an alkali, a metal carbonate and a metal bicarbonate. (4 marks)
(Carboxylic acids tezabi khasiyat kyun dikhate hain? Ethanoic acid ke active metal, alkali, metal carbonate aur metal bicarbonate ke saath reactions likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Carboxylic acids pani mein H⁺ ions dete hain, is liye in mein kafi tezabi khasiyat hai:
CH₃COOH ⇌ CH₃COO⁻ + H⁺
Is liye yeh basic species aur active metals se react karte hain (sirf acidic hydrogen wale reactions).

(a) Active metal: 2CH₃COOH + 2Na → 2CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + H₂ (hydrogen gas nikalti hai)
(b) Alkali: CH₃COOH + NaOH → CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + H₂O (neutralisation)
(c) Metal carbonate: 2CH₃COOH + Na₂CO₃ → 2CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + CO₂ + H₂O
(d) Metal bicarbonate: CH₃COOH + NaHCO₃ → CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + CO₂ + H₂O
(c) aur (d) mein carbon dioxide bulbulon ke saath nikalti hai. Har case mein namak sodium ethanoate hai.

book_ref.quote: This why they can react with the basic species and active metals.

blocks.prompt:
12 Describe the reactions of carboxylic acids in which the –OH group is replaced (by Cl and by OR), and the reduction of the –COOH group. Name a reducing agent that fails. (4 marks)
(Carboxylic acids ke woh reactions bayan karein jin mein –OH group badalta hai (Cl aur OR se), aur –COOH group ki reduction. Aik reducing agent batayein jo nakam rehta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
–OH ki tabdeeli: carboxylic acids substitution reactions karte hain jin mein –OH group kisi doosre group, jaise X, OR ya NH₂, se badal jata hai.

(a) Cl se – SOCl₂, PCl₃ ya PCl₅ ke saath acyl chloride banta hai:
CH₃COOH + SOCl₂ → CH₃COCl + HCl + SO₂
CH₃COOH + PCl₅ → CH₃COCl + HCl + POCl₃

(b) OR se – esterification: concentrated H₂SO₄ ki maujoodgi mein alcohol ke saath garam karne se ester banta hai (reversible):
CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH ⇌ CH₃COOC₂H₅ + H₂O (ethyl ethanoate)

–COOH ki reduction: taqatwar reducing agent lithium tetrahydridoaluminate(III), LiAlH₄, carboxylic acids ko primary alcohols mein reduce karta hai:
CH₃COOH + 4[H] → CH₃CH₂OH + H₂O
Doosre aam reducing agents, H₂/Ni aur sodium tetrahydridoborate(III) (NaBH₄), carboxylic acids ko reduce nahi karte.

book_ref.quote: Carboxylic acids can undergo substitution reactions in which the OH group is replaced

blocks.prompt:
13 Explain why methanoic acid behaves as a reducing agent and write its reactions with Tollens' reagent and Fehling's solution. Also give the oxidation of ethanedioic acid. (4 marks)
(Samjhayein ke methanoic acid reducing agent kyun hai aur is ke Tollens' reagent aur Fehling's solution ke saath reactions likhein. Ethanedioic acid ki oxidation bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Methanoic acid, H–COOH, mein aldehydic hissa (H–C=O) aur carboxylic hissa (–COOH) dono hain. Is structure ki wajah se yeh weak aur strong dono oxidising agents se oxidise hota hai, is liye strong reducing agent hai.

Yeh wahid monocarboxylic acid hai jo silver mirror (Tollens' test) aur Fehling's solution ke saath brick-red precipitate deta hai; in reactions se methanoic acid pehchana jata hai:
H–COOH + 2[Ag(NH₃)₂]OH → 2Ag↓ + CO₂ + 4NH₃ + 2H₂O (silver mirror)
H–COOH + 2Cu(OH)₂ → Cu₂O↓ + CO₂ + 3H₂O (brick red ppt)

Ethanedioic acid: acidified KMnO₄ (ya K₂Cr₂O₇) se carbon dioxide aur pani mein oxidise hota hai:
2KMnO₄ + 3H₂SO₄ + 5HOOC–COOH → K₂SO₄ + 2MnSO₄ + 10CO₂ + 8H₂O
Mn +7 se +2 (reduce) aur C +3 se +4 (oxidise) hota hai.

book_ref.quote: These reactions are used for the identification of methanoic acid.

blocks.prompt:
14 For the reaction 2KMnO₄ + 3H₂SO₄ + 5H₂C₂O₄ → K₂SO₄ + 2MnSO₄ + 10CO₂ + 8H₂O: (i) find the oxidation numbers of Mn and C before and after the reaction and show that the electrons lost equal the electrons gained; (ii) calculate the moles of KMnO₄ needed and of CO₂ formed for 0.25 mol of ethanedioic acid. (4 marks)
(Reaction 2KMnO₄ + 3H₂SO₄ + 5H₂C₂O₄ → K₂SO₄ + 2MnSO₄ + 10CO₂ + 8H₂O ke liye: (i) reaction se pehle aur baad Mn aur C ke oxidation numbers nikalein aur dikhayein ke kho gaye aur liye gaye electrons barabar hain; (ii) 0.25 mol ethanedioic acid ke liye KMnO₄ ke darkar moles aur bane hue CO₂ ke moles nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Formulas se oxidation numbers nikalein (K = +1, O = –2, H = +1), fi atom electrons ko atoms se zarab dein, phir balanced equation ka mole ratio istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: results in the formation of carbon dioxide and water

steps: KMnO₄ mein Mn: +1 + x + 4(–2) = 0, x = +7; MnSO₄ mein Mn: x + (–2) = 0 (SO₄²⁻ ka charge –2), x = +2. Mn 5 electrons leta hai.
H₂C₂O₄ mein C: 2(+1) + 2y + 4(–2) = 0, y = +3; CO₂ mein C: y + 2(–2) = 0, y = +4. Har C 1 electron khota hai.
2 Mn ke liye gaye electrons = 2 × 5 = 10; 10 C (5 H₂C₂O₄ mein) ke khoye electrons = 10 × 1 = 10. Barabar hain, is liye equation electrons mein balanced hai.
KMnO₄ : H₂C₂O₄ = 2 : 5, is liye KMnO₄ = 0.25 × 2/5 = 0.10 mol.
H₂C₂O₄ : CO₂ = 5 : 10 = 1 : 2, is liye CO₂ = 0.25 × 2 = 0.50 mol.
blocks.final_answer: Mn +7 → +2, C +3 → +4; 10 electrons muntaqil; KMnO₄ = 0.10 mol, CO₂ = 0.50 mol

blocks.prompt:
15 Explain, on the basis of the stability of the conjugate base, why carboxylic acids are more acidic than phenols and alcohols. How do +I and –I groups affect the acidity? Use methanoic and ethanoic acids as an example. (4 marks)
(Conjugate base ki stability ki bunyad par samjhayein ke carboxylic acids phenols aur alcohols se zyada acidic kyun hain. +I aur –I groups acidity par kya asar dalte hain? Methanoic aur ethanoic acid ki misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Acidity ki tarteeb (Table 23.1): RCOOH (Ka 10⁻⁵, pKa 5) > ArOH (10⁻¹⁰, 10) > HOH (10⁻¹⁴, 14) > R–OH (10⁻¹⁶, 16). pKa = –log Ka, is liye zyada Ka ya kam pKa ka matlab strong acid.

Conjugate base: acid ke ionization ki had us ke conjugate base ki stability par munhasir hai.
CH₃COOH ⇌ CH₃COO⁻ + H⁺
Ethanoate ion mein negative charge –COO⁻ group (carbon aur dono oxygen) par phail jata hai, is liye oxygen par charge ki shiddat kam ho jati hai. Stable ion H⁺ le kar wapas acid banne ka kam imkan rakhta hai, is liye acid zyada ionise hota hai.

Substituents ka asar:
• Electron donating group (+I) negative charge barhata hai, carboxylate ion ko unstable karta hai aur acidity kam karta hai.
• Electron withdrawing group (–I) negative charge phailata hai, carboxylate ion ko stable karta hai aur acidity barhata hai.

Misaal: methanoic acid ethanoic acid se takreeban 10 guna strong hai. Hydrogen reference hai aur is ka –I effect nahi; ethanoic acid ke CH₃ group ka +I effect ethanoate ko unstable karta hai.

book_ref.quote: making it less likely to accept H⁺ ions to form undissociated acid molecule

blocks.prompt:
16 Three carboxylic acids have Ka values: acid A 6.3 × 10⁻⁵, acid B 1.8 × 10⁻⁵, acid C 3.2 × 10⁻³; a phenol has Ka 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁰. Calculate the pKa of each, arrange them in order of decreasing acid strength, and find how many times stronger acid C is than acid B. (4 marks)
(Teen carboxylic acids ke Ka: acid A 6.3 × 10⁻⁵, acid B 1.8 × 10⁻⁵, acid C 3.2 × 10⁻³; aik phenol ka Ka 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁰ hai. Har aik ka pKa nikalein, ghat-ti acid strength ki tarteeb mein likhein, aur batayein ke acid C acid B se kitne guna strong hai.)
blocks.explanation: pKa = –log Ka istemal karein; pKa jitna kam (Ka zyada), acid utna strong; taqat ka muqabla Ka ke ratio se karein.

book_ref.quote: The relative values of acidity constant or ionization constant, Ka

steps: Sab se kam pKa sab se strong: C (2.49) > A (4.20) > B (4.74) > phenol (10.00)
Ka(C) / Ka(B) = 3.2 × 10⁻³ / 1.8 × 10⁻⁵ = 178, is liye C, B se takreeban 1.8 × 10² guna strong hai.
blocks.final_answer: pKa: A 4.20, B 4.74, C 2.49, phenol 10.00; tarteeb C > A > B > phenol; C, B se takreeban 178 guna strong

blocks.prompt:
17 The pKa values of ethanoic acid, chloroethanoic acid, dichloroethanoic acid and trichloroethanoic acid are 4.74, 2.86, 1.26 and 0.64. Calculate the Ka of each acid, find how many times stronger trichloroethanoic acid is than ethanoic acid, and explain the trend. (4 marks)
(Ethanoic acid, chloroethanoic acid, dichloroethanoic acid aur trichloroethanoic acid ke pKa 4.74, 2.86, 1.26 aur 0.64 hain. Har acid ka Ka nikalein, batayein ke trichloroethanoic acid ethanoic acid se kitne guna strong hai, aur trend samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Ka = 10^–pKa; do Ka ka ratio un ke pKa ke farq ki power par 10 hai; Cl ke –I effect se samjhayein.

book_ref.quote: Dichloroethanoic acid (Cl₂CH-COOH) is stronger, with a pKa of 1.26

steps: Trend: har Cl atom ka –I effect carboxylate ion ka negative charge phaila kar use stable karta hai; zyada Cl atoms, zyada stability, zyada Ka aur kam pKa. Trichloroethanoic acid kuch mineral acids jitna strong hai.
blocks.final_answer: Ka: 1.8 × 10⁻⁵, 1.4 × 10⁻³, 5.5 × 10⁻², 2.3 × 10⁻¹; trichloroethanoic acid ethanoic acid se takreeban 1.3 × 10⁴ guna strong

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: pKa ka 1 ka farq Ka mein 10 guna farq hai. Ethanoic (4.74) aur trichloro (0.64) mein takreeban 4 ka farq hai, is liye taqat mein takreeban 10⁴ guna farq.

blocks.prompt:
18 What are esters? Explain their physical properties in terms of hydrogen bonding and give their uses. (4 marks)
(Esters kya hain? In ki physical properties hydrogen bonding ke hawale se samjhayein aur in ke istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Esters carboxylic acids ke derivatives hain jo un ke alcohols ke saath reaction se bante hain, jaise ethyl ethanoate, CH₃COOC₂H₅.

Physical properties:
• Hydrogen bonding: alcohols aur carboxylic acids ke bar-aks esters apne molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds nahi bana sakte.
• Boiling point: is liye in ke boiling points mutaliqa alcohols aur carboxylic acids se kam hain. Ethyl ethanoate 77 °C par ubalta hai (ethanoic acid 118 °C); kam boiling point ka matlab zyada volatility, is liye ester zyada volatile hai.
• Solubility: hydrogen bonds na hone se esters pani mein kam hal ya na-hal hain.
• Khushbu: bahut se (volatile) esters meethi phalon jaisi khushbu wale liquids hain; phalon ki khushbu aur zaiqa esters ki wajah se hai.

Istemal: solvents ke taur par, aur fruit drinks aur mithaiyon mein flavouring agents.

book_ref.quote: Esters, unlike alcohols and carboxylic acids have no ability to form the hydrogen bond.

blocks.prompt:
19 Describe the methods of preparing esters from (i) a carboxylic acid and an alcohol, (ii) an acyl chloride and an alcohol, (iii) an acyl chloride and phenol. Also write the hydrolysis of an aromatic ester. (4 marks)
(Esters banane ke tareeqe bayan karein: (i) carboxylic acid aur alcohol se, (ii) acyl chloride aur alcohol se, (iii) acyl chloride aur phenol se. Aik aromatic ester ki hydrolysis bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Carboxylic acid + alcohol (Fischer's esterification): acidic medium (conc. H₂SO₄) mein ester aur pani bante hain; reaction equilibrium hai.
CH₃CH₂COOH + C₂H₅OH ⇌ CH₃CH₂COOC₂H₅ + H₂O (ethyl propanoate)
Aam tor par: RCOOH + R'OH ⇌ RCOOR' + H₂O (acid ka –OH aur alcohol ka H pani ban kar nikalte hain).

(ii) Acyl chloride + alcohol: tezi se react karta hai; reaction mukammal hota hai aur equilibrium mixture nahi banta.
CH₃COCl + C₂H₅OH → CH₃COOC₂H₅ + HCl (ethyl ethanoate)

(iii) Acyl chloride + phenol: acyl chloride ko phenol ke saath garam karne par phenyl esters bante hain.
CH₃COCl + C₆H₅OH → CH₃COOC₆H₅ + HCl (phenyl ethanoate)

Hydrolysis: ester aahista (acid ya base catalysed) carboxylic acid aur alcohol (ya phenol) mein hydrolyse hota hai; aromatic esters bhi isi tarah:
C₆H₅COOC₂H₅ + H₂O → C₆H₅COOH + C₂H₅OH (ethyl benzoate → benzoic acid + ethanol)

book_ref.quote: Acyl chlorides react vigorously with alcohols to form esters and their reactions go to completion

blocks.prompt:
20 What are acyl chlorides? Give their general formula and naming, how they are prepared from carboxylic acids, and why they are used to make other derivatives, with two reactions. (4 marks)
(Acyl chlorides kya hain? In ka general formula aur naam rakhne ka tareeqa, carboxylic acids se in ki tayyari, aur yeh doosre derivatives banane mein kyun istemal hote hain, do reactions ke saath batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Acyl chlorides ka functional group –COCl hai. Saturated aliphatic acyl chlorides ka general formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₁COCl hai. IUPAC system mein inhein alkanoyl halides kehte hain: CH₃COCl ethanoyl chloride, CH₃CH₂COCl propanoyl chloride.

Tayyari: carboxylic acid ka –OH SOCl₂, PCl₃ ya PCl₅ se Cl mein badla jata hai:
CH₃COOH + SOCl₂ → CH₃COCl + HCl + SO₂
CH₃COOH + PCl₅ → CH₃COCl + HCl + POCl₃

Reactivity aur istemal: acyl chlorides carboxylic acids ke functional derivatives mein sab se reactive hain (carbonyl carbon par bara δ⁺ hai kyun ke O aur Cl dono electrons khainchte hain), is liye yeh doosre derivatives banane ke liye tayyar kiye jate hain:
• alcohol ke saath (mukammal reaction): CH₃COCl + C₂H₅OH → CH₃COOC₂H₅ + HCl
• pani ke saath (chand minutes mein): CH₃COCl + H₂O → CH₃COOH + HCl
• phenol ke saath garam karne par: phenyl esters.

book_ref.quote: Since acyl chlorides are the most reactive compounds among the functional derivatives of carboxylic acids

blocks.prompt:
21 Ethanoyl chloride, chloroethane and chlorobenzene are each treated with water. Write the equations where reaction occurs, and justify the order of their ease of hydrolysis from their structures. (4 marks)
(Ethanoyl chloride, chloroethane aur chlorobenzene ko alag alag pani ke saath rakha jata hai. Jahan reaction ho wahan equations likhein, aur in ki structures se hydrolysis ki aasani ki tarteeb ko durust sabit karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Hydrolysis ki aasani ki tarteeb: ethanoyl chloride > chloroethane > chlorobenzene (koi reaction nahi). Har case mein pani nucleophile ban kar δ⁺ carbon par hamla karta hai.

Ethanoyl chloride: CH₃COCl + H₂O → CH₃COOH + HCl
Carbonyl carbon do bahut electronegative atoms, O aur Cl, se juda hai jin ka strong electron withdrawing effect use bara δ⁺ deta hai. H₂O ka nucleophilic hamla itna tez hai ke reaction chand minutes mein mukammal ho jata hai.

Chloroethane: C₂H₅Cl + H₂O → C₂H₅OH + HCl
Carbon sirf aik chlorine se juda hai, is liye nisbatan kam δ⁺ hai. Pani ka hamla aahista hai aur mixture ko der tak garam karna parta hai.

Chlorobenzene: hydrolysis nahi hoti.
C–Cl wala carbon benzene ring ka hissa hai. Chlorine ka lone pair ring ke π electrons ke saath delocalise hota hai aur C–Cl bond mein double bond character aa jata hai. Bond itna mazboot ho jata hai ke nahi toot-ta.

book_ref.quote: Here, lone pair on chlorine participates in delocalization with π electrons of the benzene ring.

rows: Sab se tez (minutes): C, O aur Cl se juda, bara δ⁺
Aahista (garmi chahiye): C sirf Cl se juda, kam δ⁺
Reaction nahi: C–Cl mein double bond character
